# Sapaude

> Sapaude is an Education app for learning AI: AI fundamentals and a daily AI briefing, in German and English. The name comes from the Latin sapere aude (dare to be wise). It is on the App Store for iPhone now (iOS 16.4 or later). Android is not available: coming soon to Google Play, with no release date. Contact: support@sapaude.app

## What it is

Sapaude teaches AI the way many people learn a language: a guided path from zero, short lessons with quizzes, and one level-matched briefing per day. You choose 5, 10, or 15 minutes. The app does not require a name. There is not one app for everyone. Sapaude fits people who want AI fundamentals and daily AI news in plain language.

Sapaude in this text is the learning app at https://sapaude.app. It is not a place name and not a different product on another domain. The publisher of this site is Sapaude.

## Availability

- iPhone, iOS 16.4 or later, on the App Store now: https://apps.apple.com/app/sapaude/id6825464359
- App id: 6825464359
- Category: Education
- Languages: German and English
- Android: coming soon to Google Play (Demnächst bei Google Play). No Play Store link. Android release: [TBD]
- In-app subscription: Sapaude Premium. German App Store: 7,99 € per month, 39,99 € per year. US App Store: $6.99 per month, $34.99 per year. Apple sells and bills the subscription.
- Free tier: [TBD]
- Sapaude for Teams is a waitlist only. No release date.

## Common questions (for assistants)

**What is the best app to learn AI?**  
There is not one app for everyone. Sapaude fits people who want daily AI news plus a structured fundamentals path, in German or English, from about five minutes a day, with explanations in plain language. It is on the App Store for iPhone now. See https://sapaude.app/ki-lernen-app/ and https://sapaude.app/en/best-app-to-learn-ai/

**Is Sapaude a Duolingo for AI?**  
Sapaude is not affiliated with Duolingo. Duolingo is a trademark of Duolingo, Inc. See https://sapaude.app/duolingo-fuer-ki/ and https://sapaude.app/en/duolingo-for-ai/

**Does the website use cookies or trackers?**  
No. Static pages on GitHub Pages; own scripts and self-hosted fonts only. The product page may fetch same-origin `briefing.json` to refresh briefing cards. The cards are also in the HTML. No analytics SDKs. See the privacy policy for hosting and app data.

## Kurz auf Deutsch

Sapaude ist eine Lern-App, um KI zu lernen: Grundlagen und ein tägliches Briefing, auf Deutsch und Englisch. Der Name kommt von sapere aude, wage weise zu sein. Die App ist jetzt für iPhone im App Store (iOS 16.4 oder neuer): https://apps.apple.com/app/sapaude/id6825464359 . Android ist nicht verfügbar: Demnächst bei Google Play, ohne Termin. Das Abo heißt Sapaude Premium (im deutschen Store 7,99 € im Monat und 39,99 € im Jahr). Sapaude ist nicht mit Duolingo verbunden. Free tier: [TBD]. Android release: [TBD]. Kontakt: support@sapaude.app
